name: rn
description: Give a goal, roughly: rn works out the plan and the design with you, then carries the work through without you — one agent makes each task, another evaluates it — and calls you back only for the plan, design, and deliverable sign-offs and the decisions that are yours (/rn:ty approve, /rn:gm feedback). The session lives in git, so it resumes across conversations (/rn:dn, /rn:up).
